title: Utas komentar LinkedIn soal UNESCO

images.alt: Utas komentar LinkedIn: komentar Rahmat Wibowo yang meneruskan pernyataan UNESCO Jakarta, dan komentar akun Abil S., Founder of ASSAI

shows: Komentar Rahmat Wibowo (ditandai 43m) yang meneruskan pernyataan yang disebut berasal dari UNESCO Jakarta (tidak ada kontrak kerja atau konsultansi dengan UNESCO Jakarta; peran di KORIKA perlu dikonfirmasi ke KORIKA), dan, pada utas yang sama, komentar akun “Abil S. — Founder of ASSAI” (ditandai 44m): “my biggest achievement is low resting heart rate”.
limits: Gambar tidak menunjukkan bahwa komentar Abil S. menjawab pernyataan UNESCO: komentarnya ditandai lebih lama (44m) daripada komentar Rahmat (43m). Pernyataan UNESCO disampaikan tidak langsung oleh penulis; surat atau dokumen dari UNESCO tidak ditampilkan. Tanggal tidak terlihat.

en.title: LinkedIn comment thread about UNESCO
alts: LinkedIn comment thread: a comment by Rahmat Wibowo relaying a statement from UNESCO Jakarta, and a comment from the account "Abil S., Founder of ASSAI"
en.shows: A comment by Rahmat Wibowo (marked 43m) relaying a statement said to come from UNESCO Jakarta (no employment or consultancy contract with UNESCO Jakarta; the role at KORIKA needs to be confirmed with KORIKA), and, in the same thread, a comment from the account "Abil S. — Founder of ASSAI" (marked 44m): "my biggest achievement is low resting heart rate".
en.limits: The image does not show that Abil S.'s comment answers the UNESCO statement: his comment is marked older (44m) than Rahmat's (43m). The UNESCO statement is relayed indirectly by the author; no letter or document from UNESCO is shown. The date is not visible.
